page_summary: This page provides an overview of the Return on Security Investment (ROSI) calculation, detailing key inputs such as Single Loss Expectancy (SLE), Annual Rate of Occurrence (ARO), and Annual Loss Expectancy (ALE). It outlines the core calculation for ROSI and practical steps for quantifying baseline risk, estimating control mitigation rates, and performing sensitivity analysis. The page emphasizes that ROSI should be used as a decision support tool within a broader risk assessment framework.
